title: Wolf and Green Oracle
description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a green-skinned woman in profile with an elaborate headdress of swirling blue and purple spiral curls. A green wolf-like creature on the left nuzzles her face, its single visible eye replaced by a large red stylized all-seeing eye with radiating golden lines.
prompt: surreal profile portrait of a green-skinned woman with intricate swirling blue and purple spiral curls forming an elaborate headdress, a green wolf-like creature nuzzling her face from the left, the wolf has a large stylized red eye with black cracks and radiating golden light beams, dramatic radiating background in orange and red, vibrant psychedelic colors, symbolic and mystical atmosphere
